newsitem.title: USA: McWhorter to buy rest of joint venture.
newsitem.headline: McWhorter to buy rest of joint venture.

text.p: McWhorter Technologies Inc said Tuesday it agreed to buy the two-thirds of McWhorter Technolgies Europe that it does not already own from two joint venture partners.

McWhorter did not disclose how much it was spending to acquire the rest of resin supply company. Under the deal the company will buy shares in the joint venture from Kemira Oy's Tikkurila Oy in Vantaa, Finland and AB Wilh. Beckerin Stockholm.
"The acquisition of 100 percent of McWhorter Technologies Europe is the next step in our planned European expansion," John Stevenson, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"McWhorter Technologies Europe will be consolidated with our recent acquisition Syntech S.p.A. to create a Pan European resin supply company," Stevenson continued.

"We are also pleased to announce that Giulio Napoli, Syntech's managing director, will assume the position of president of McWhorter Technologies Europe. Mr. Napoli will be responsible for all of McWhorter's activities in Europe and Asia."
